description: Scala object 'HadoopCodecStreams' providing utilities for Hadoop compression codecs and input stream creation, including support for Spark's Zstandard codec and handling of non-standard file extensions.

methods.name: getDecompressionCodec
methods.description: Returns an optional CompressionCodec based on file extension or name, supporting standard and non-standard extensions.

methods.name: createZstdInputStream
methods.description: Creates an InputStream with Zstandard compression if the file extension matches, using Spark's Zstandard codec.

methods.name: createInputStream
methods.description: Creates an InputStream for a file, applying decompression codecs if applicable, with fallback to Spark's Zstandard codec.
